title: Grateful Dead Live at Reed's Ranch on 1969-07-03
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar July‑1969 show, highlighted by a unique Casey Jones and a beautiful He Was a Friend of Mine.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers unanimously praise this recording as one of the best from that era, noting crystal‑clear instrument separation and superb mix quality thanks to Charlie Miller’s work. Musically the set shines with an extraordinary take on “Casey Jones” and a moving rendition of “He Was a Friend of Mine,” driving the overall enthusiasm for the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are five‑star, consistently lauding both the musical performance and the pristine soundboard recording; no negatives were mentioned.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as great, crisp, and able to hear every instrument and voice clearly; Charlie Miller’s engineering is repeatedly praised.

standout_songs: He Was a Friend of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is regarded as a ‘darn good’ performance with unique treatment of Casey Jones and an overall warm, engaging flow.
